summary: Completed e2e testing of Enhanced Route Request System for Up-Wash Power Washing. All 18 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI features verified working - contractor can request routes with pricing displayed, admin can approve/deny requests with payment link generation, payment page loads with correct summary, and routes are auto-added to contractor's My Routes upon payment.

POST /api/contractor/route-requests - creates request with 3 routes + truck ($1295)
GET /api/contractor/route-requests - contractor can view own requests
GET /api/admin/route-requests - admin can view all requests with pricing
Contractor My Routes shows purchased routes
Truck pickup notification created with 8 AM pickup time
Request status updated to paid after payment
Auth required for all route request endpoints
Contractor cannot access admin route request endpoints

Deny button works - marks request as denied

seed_data_creation: Created multiple route requests during testing. Some requests were approved, some denied, some paid.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Enhanced Route Request System fully functional. Key flows tested:
1) Contractor creates route request with zip codes, num routes, truck rental
2) Admin approves → payment link generated → contractor sees in Request Routes page
3) Contractor clicks payment link → Payment Page shows summary with NO REFUNDS warning
4) Payment complete → routes added to My Routes, truck pickup notification sent
5) Admin can also deny requests → contractor sees DENIED badge
Pricing: $400/route + $95 truck rental (flat fee). Square payment MOCKED - actual payment nonce not required.
